characteristics.name: Constitution
characteristics.notes: Resists poison/disease; hit points; death at 0.

characteristics.name: Size
characteristics.notes: Mass; hit points and damage modifier; no roll of its own.

characteristics.name: Intelligence
characteristics.notes: Personal skill points INT×10; no fixed maximum.

characteristics.name: Power
characteristics.notes: Power points; basis for powers; no fixed maximum.

characteristics.name: Dexterity
characteristics.notes: DEX rank (combat order); Dodge base DEX×2.

characteristics.name: Charisma
characteristics.notes: First impressions; number of distinctive features.

characteristics.name: Education
characteristics.notes: Optional 8th characteristic; +1 per full decade of extra age.

options.rule: Roll 3D6 seven times and assign freely; SIZ and INT at least 8.

pointBuy.refund: lowering below 10 refunds the same cost per point
pointBuy.note: Superhuman: normal characteristic maximums do not apply.

age.aging: At 50 and each full decade after: -1 to one of STR/CON/DEX/CHA; at 80+: three of them each decade.

derived.name: Damage modifier
derived.formulaText: STR+SIZ on the damage modifier table
derived.notes: Full for brawl/melee; positive bonus halved (round up) for thrown and bows; none for firearms/energy weapons.

derived.name: Hit points
derived.notes: Unconscious at 2 or less; dies at end of next round at 0 or below.

derived.name: Power points
derived.notes: Can temporarily hold up to 2×POW extra points; faint at 0.

derived.name: Fatigue points
derived.notes: -1% to all rolls per point below 0; incapacitated at -(STR+CON); regain 1/minute resting.

derived.name: Encumbrance limits
derived.formulaText: carry STR easily; move normally up to (STR+CON)/2

hitPointsByLocation.note: The book's own HP-per-location grid (p14) does not always equal these fractions (e.g. 14 HP gives chest 6 by the grid, ceil(5.6)=6; arm 4): prefer the grid if they differ.

simpleOption.note: Table lists e.g. DEX/2; text says half the primary, rounded up.

skillCategoryBonus.note: Seven categories are named in the chapter intro but six have modifier rows; Shield/Parry sit under Combat.

skills.name: Appraise
skills.effect: Judge an object's worth, quality or authenticity.

skills.name: Art
skills.effect: Make creative work in one chosen medium.

skills.name: Artillery
skills.effect: Crew and fire large emplaced or vehicle guns; base set by weapon.

skills.name: Bargain
skills.effect: Haggle a better price or trade deal.

skills.name: Brawl
skills.effect: Untrained punching, kicking and head-butting.

skills.name: Climb
skills.effect: Scale walls, trees, cliffs and ropes.

skills.name: Command
skills.effect: Lead and coordinate others under pressure.

skills.name: Craft
skills.effect: Make or mend practical goods in one trade.

skills.name: Demolition
skills.effect: Place, set and disarm explosives.

skills.name: Disguise
skills.effect: Change appearance and manner to pass as someone else.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.effect: Evade attacks; each success level of the dodge downgrades the hit a step.

skills.name: Drive
skills.effect: Operate a ground vehicle; 20% for familiar types, 01% for unfamiliar.

skills.name: Energy Weapon
skills.effect: Fire beam and blaster weapons; base by weapon.

skills.name: Etiquette
skills.effect: Know and follow a group's manners and protocol.

skills.name: Fast Talk
skills.effect: Bluff or confuse someone into quick, short-lived agreement.

skills.name: Fine Manipulation
skills.effect: Delicate hand work: picking locks, defusing, tiny parts.

skills.name: Firearm
skills.effect: Shoot guns of one class; base by weapon.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.effect: Emergency treatment that restores a few hit points.

skills.name: Fly
skills.effect: Manoeuvre in the air without a vehicle; DEX×4 if winged, else half DEX.

skills.name: Gaming
skills.effect: Play and win games of chance and strategy.

skills.name: Grapple
skills.effect: Seize, hold, throw or pin an opponent.

skills.name: Heavy Machine
skills.effect: Run large industrial or military machinery.

skills.name: Heavy Weapon
skills.effect: Use crew-served or launcher weapons between rifles and artillery.

skills.name: Hide
skills.effect: Conceal yourself or an object from view.

skills.name: Insight
skills.effect: Read motives, moods and lies in others.

skills.name: Jump
skills.effect: Leap distances and heights; land safely from short drops.

skills.name: Knowledge
skills.effect: Academic or lore knowledge in one field; some fields start at 00%.

skills.name: Language (Own)
skills.effect: Native tongue; starts at INT×5 (or EDU×5).

skills.name: Language (Other)
skills.effect: A learned foreign language; starts at 00%.

skills.name: Listen
skills.effect: Notice and interpret sounds.

skills.name: Literacy
skills.effect: Optional: read and write a language; 00% or equal to that Language.

skills.name: Martial Arts
skills.effect: Trained unarmed fighting; a success boosts unarmed damage.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.effect: Diagnose and treat illness and serious injury over time.

skills.name: Melee Weapon
skills.effect: Fight with hand weapons of one class; base by weapon.

skills.name: Missile Weapon
skills.effect: Use bows, slings, crossbows and similar; base by weapon.

skills.name: Navigate
skills.effect: Find your way and position by landmarks, stars or instruments.

skills.name: Parry
skills.effect: Block attacks with a weapon; base by weapon.

skills.name: Perform
skills.effect: Entertain an audience in one performing art.

skills.name: Persuade
skills.effect: Convince others through reasoned argument over time.

skills.name: Pilot
skills.effect: Operate an air, water or space craft of one type.

skills.name: Projection
skills.effect: Optional: aim ranged powers at a target.

skills.name: Psychotherapy
skills.effect: Treat mental illness; base 01% or 00% by era.

skills.name: Repair
skills.effect: Fix broken devices or structures of one kind.

skills.name: Research
skills.effect: Find information in libraries, archives or databases.

skills.name: Ride
skills.effect: Control a riding animal at speed or in danger.

skills.name: Science
skills.effect: Theory and method of one scientific field.

skills.name: Sense
skills.effect: Notice by smell, taste or touch, or sense something off.

skills.name: Shield
skills.effect: Block or bash with a shield; base set per shield.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.effect: Palm, pick pockets and perform hand tricks unseen.

skills.name: Spot
skills.effect: Notice hidden or easily-missed things by sight.

skills.name: Status
skills.effect: Standing and credit within a society; tied to wealth.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.effect: Move quietly and unseen.

skills.name: Strategy
skills.effect: Plan campaigns and anticipate an enemy's moves.

skills.name: Swim
skills.effect: Stay afloat and move through water.

skills.name: Teach
skills.effect: Pass a skill on to a student.

skills.name: Technical Skill
skills.effect: Use and operate one class of technology.

skills.name: Throw
skills.effect: Throw objects or thrown weapons accurately.

skills.name: Track
skills.effect: Follow a trail by its signs.

professional.rule: Spend only on the profession's skills; cap includes base chance and bonuses; excess must go elsewhere.

personal.rule: Any skills; same creation cap; GM may cap off-profession skills.

skillPoints.note: Rating = base + category bonus (opt.) + personality + professional + personal; keep professional and personal pools separate.

success.formula: roll <= skill (01–05 always succeed if base chance >= 5%)

fumble.formulaText: text: 1/20 of the failure chance; table: 96–00 for skill ≤20, 97–00 ≤40, 98–00 ≤60, 99–00 ≤80, 00 above; 00 always fumbles

successLevels.note: Formulas reproduce the Skill Results Table bands; the prose rule (5% of failure chance) differs at some band edges.

levels.note: book says halved; rounding not checked

levels.rule: no roll, or 01% at GM discretion

resistance.note: Difference of 10+ is automatic success/failure; GM may still allow 01 to succeed / 00 to fail. Table on p129–130 covers 1–24.

augments.augment: successful roll of the other skill shifts difficulty one step (failure shifts the other way)

experience.check: once per adventure per successfully used skill (not Easy rolls)
experience.roll: D100 over current skill, experience bonus added (see p13)

order.rule: Statements and actions in DEX-rank order, highest first; ties broken by the relevant skill; may delay down to rank 1.
order.missileFirst: within one rank, missile attacks resolve before melee
order.movementPenalty: move 6–15 m: act at DEX/2; 16–29 m: DEX/4

powers.rule: Powers go off in the Powers phase in INT-rank order, highest first.

locationDamage.rule: damage >= location HP disables it; >= 2× maims/severs; >= 3× may kill (head/chest/abdomen)

successInCombat.critical: ignores armour; special effect by damage type

dodge.rule: success turns a hit into a miss; each higher dodge level downgrades the attack one more step

majorWound.effects: roll 1D100 on the Major Wound Table; shock: can act only for rounds equal to current HP; at 2 HP or less collapse for an hour

rows.effect: Head or sense injury; some skills capped at 65%
One arm's nerves damaged; use other arm

armor.rule: Subtract armour value from each hit's damage; 0 or less = no damage; shield AV also applies when a parry is beaten
armor.fit: each armour has a Fits SIZ ± range; outside it, it cannot be worn

resource.spend: levels × spell cost/level on success; 1 PP on failure; full cost on fumble
resource.recovery: Power Point Recovery Rate Table; typically 1/hour asleep, 1 per 2 hours awake

creation.skillPoints: may spend Step Three personal points, and Step Seven professional points if Occultist/Priest/Shaman/Wizard

cost.skill: each spell is a Mental skill rolled on d100; starts at int*1

successLevels.fumble: all intended PP lost, spell locked 1 round; damage spells Luck roll or hit wrong target
successLevels.special: special damage type or ×1.5 range/effect or level ×1.5 for resistance
successLevels.critical: max damage ignoring armor, or ×2 effect / ×2 level for resistance

rules.note: One spell per combat round; cast at DEX rank minus spell level; counts as attack action.
Spell level cap = ceil(INT/2); if delay pushes below DEX rank 0, it resolves next round.
Unwilling living target: resistance roll vs POW or PP (per spell); willing/beneficial skip; helpless auto-fail.
Same spell never stacks; highest level wins, lower one resumes if still running.
Ready/dismiss takes 1 hour each; memory survives sleep/unconsciousness.
Casting straight from a grimoire takes 1 round per level; foreign grimoire needs Language and INT×1 per spell.
Familiar: SIZ ≤ ceil(POW/4); 3 months ritual, 1 POW + POW contest; range POW m; draw its PP/fatigue, share senses (1 PP/turn), commands 1 PP each; death = 1D6 dmg, 1D6 SAN.
Staff: 6 months, 1 permanent POW; holds PP = POW−1, regenerates, dies at 0 PP; 20 HP (25 non-staff); +1D6 dmg for 1 PP if staff PP beats target PP.
Beat an equal-or-higher POW in a POW contest -> POW check, +1D3−1 on improvement, once per adventure.
Learn: 1 month + INT+POW roll -> INT×1. Invent: 6 successful monthly INT+POW rolls; each failure adds a month.
Non-magician: floor(INT/4) spell levels total, (30−INT) weeks to learn each, no research.
Apprenticeship (30−INT) months; capacity rises to ceil(INT/2); emerges with 4 spells at INT×1.
Default range 100 m with line of sight; spells resolve in Powers phase.
Protection = vs physical damage; Resistance = vs heat/cold environment; a flaming weapon can trigger both.

list.name: Blast
list.effect: Magic beam deals 1D6 per level to one target; armor applies, dodgeable.

list.name: Change
list.effect: Reshape a being/object into same-kingdom form, 3 SIZ per level; POW contest if unwilling.

list.name: Conjure (type) Elemental
list.cost: 1 PP per point of elemental POW
list.effect: Summon or dismiss one elemental of a chosen type; needs full attention.

list.name: Control
list.effect: Dominate one intelligent being per level after POW vs POW; caster must concentrate.

list.name: Countermagic
list.effect: Shield that reflects incoming spells back at their caster.

list.name: Dark
list.effect: Fill an area with magical darkness.

list.name: Diminish
list.effect: After POW contest, lower target STR, CON, SIZ or DEX by 1 per level.

list.name: Dispel
list.effect: Cancel existing spell effects; can banish summoned supernatural beings.

list.name: Dull
list.effect: Lower a weapon’s hit chance and damage.

list.name: Enhance
list.effect: Raise one of the target’s characteristics by 1 per level.

list.name: Fire
list.effect: Ranged fire attack, 1D6 per level.

list.name: Frost
list.effect: Ranged cold attack, 1D6 per level.

list.name: Heal
list.effect: Restore 1D6 hit points per level.

list.name: Illusion
list.effect: Create an illusion of 3 SIZ per level.

list.name: Invisibility
list.effect: Make 3 SIZ per level of a person or object unseen.

list.name: Lift
list.effect: Levitate 3 SIZ per level of a person or object.

list.name: Light
list.effect: Fill an area with light.

list.name: Lightning
list.effect: Ranged electric attack, 1D6 per level.

list.name: Perception
list.effect: Detect one chosen kind of thing within range.

list.name: Protection
list.effect: +1 armor per level vs physical attacks (not environmental).

list.name: Resistance
list.effect: Cut heat/cold environmental damage by 1 per level (not attacks).

list.name: Seal
list.effect: Bond two inanimate objects together.

list.name: Sharpen
list.effect: Raise a weapon’s hit chance and damage.

list.name: Speak to Mind
list.effect: Two-way mental speech between caster and a target.

list.name: Teleport
list.effect: Instantly move 3 SIZ per level to a point within range.

list.name: Unseal
list.effect: Separate two joined objects (counters Seal).

list.name: Vision
list.effect: Scry events at a distant place or in the past.

list.name: Wall
list.effect: Raise a protective magical barrier.

list.name: Ward
list.effect: Four attuned markers guard ~9 m²; acts as Countermagic + Blast on crossers.

list.name: Wounding
list.effect: Touch attack inflicting 1D6 damage per level.

resource.type: none (passive); some use POT (potency) for resistance rolls
resource.note: no levels; minor or major grades; CON = initial CON before mutation

normal.method: roll d100 twice on Random Mutations Table (GM may allow picking)
normal.adverseRule: on adverse result, Luck roll; success = roll again, repeat until a failed Luck or a beneficial result

heroic.note: 2 majors only with GM OK; >4 adverse needs GM

superhuman.note: majors recommended; above-major = 3 picks with GM

cost.model: picks: minor = 1, major = 2 (same mutation twice); adverse picks add beneficial picks 1:1

rules.note: Mutagen exposure grants a new (usually minor) mutation, picked or rolled.
Evolution: mutagen shifts an existing mutation one step (minor<->major, or removes minor adverse).
Transformation: chrysalis for ~CON days, GM-approved, swap any mutations as at creation.
Each +1 CON: gain a minor mutation, or upgrade/downgrade one by a step; CON loss removes nothing.
Random table 91–00: player/GM choice or reroll.
D10: 1 STR,2 CON,3 SIZ,4 INT,5 POW,6 DEX,7 CHA,8 STR+SIZ,9 roll 2× on D8,0 roll 3× on D8. D6 size: 1–3 1D6, 4–5 2D6, 6 3D6.

entries.name: GM or player choice (pick or reroll)

list.name: Adaptability
list.effect: Survive one chosen extreme; doubles characteristic in resistance vs it. Major: heat/cold/vacuum.

list.name: Allergy
list.effect: Contact with allergen: −20% skills (minor); major also 1D6 dmg per 15 min and −40%.

list.name: Biped (Quadruped)
list.effect: Forced to the other stance; minor upright CON rounds, major Agility roll each round.

list.name: Camouflage
list.effect: Concealing skin/colour: Hide +20% minor, +40% major (chameleon shifting).

list.name: Coloration
list.effect: Striking unnatural skin/fur colour; cosmetic, minor only.

list.name: Congenital Disease
list.effect: Incurable ailment: one characteristic −1D6 (minor), two characteristics (major).

list.name: Decreased Characteristic
list.effect: Roll on Characteristic Change Table to lower stats; major doubles; min 1.

list.name: Disease Carrier
list.effect: Immune carrier of a POT 2D10 disease (major 4D10 or two); range CON m if not touch.

list.name: Group Intelligence
list.effect: Hive-mind link: minor vague, CON m range; major full telepathic, unlimited range. GM approval.

list.name: Hands
list.effect: Extra prehensile limb(s)/tail (major: two sets); may grant extra actions.

list.name: Hardy
list.effect: Halve one damage type; major also acts down to −CON HP.

list.name: Hybrid
list.effect: Animal hybrid features; claws 1D6 or bite 1D4; major may include minor Natural Weaponry.

list.name: Increased Characteristic

list.effect: One sense +20% skill (major +40%), range ×2/×4; overload may stun (Idea roll).

list.name: Luminescence

list.name: Metabolic Improvement

list.name: Metabolic Weakness

list.name: Natural Armor
list.effect: Hide/scales: 3 armor minor (1D3 random), 6 major (1D3+3); stacks with worn armor.

list.name: Natural Weaponry
list.effect: +1D6 Brawl dmg or 1D6 projectile at DEX m; major +2D6 and double range.

list.name: Pain Sensitivity
list.effect: Stamina vs stun when hit; damage vs CON or out 1D6 rounds; major doubles one dmg type.

list.name: Pheromone
list.effect: Chemicals evoke one emotion, POT 2D6 vs INT, CON m range; major choose per turn, POT 4D6.

list.name: Reduced Sense
list.effect: One sense impaired (skills Difficult); major removes it (skills 0%).

list.name: Regeneration
list.effect: Heal 1 HP/minute (major 1 HP/round); one chosen injury type never heals.

list.name: Sensitivity
list.effect: Auto-sense one substance class within CON m (major CON miles).

list.name: Speech (Mimicry)
list.effect: Mimic animal sounds, +20% language/Disguise, animal tongue at INT×2; major +40%, more.

list.name: Structural Improvement
list.effect: Beneficial body form: +2D6 to one characteristic/armor/MOV; major 4D6 spread, not POW.

list.name: Structural Weakness
list.effect: Malformed body: −2D6 to one characteristic or MOV; major −4D6 spread, min 1.

list.name: Venom
list.effect: Poison via bite/sting/spit, POT 2D6 (major 4D6); ranged CON m.

list.name: Wings
list.effect: Fly at MOV (major MOV×2); Fly skill DEX×2 (major DEX×4); carry STR in SIZ.

resource.spend: spent regardless of outcome; failure costs only 1 if cost >1; fumble costs full; sub-1/round costs only charged after roll

creation.skillPoints: personal pool; professional pool too in settings where psychics are institutional; Mental category bonus if used

cost.skill: each ability is a d100 skill, base pow*1
cost.resistance: POW vs POW or PP vs PP (per ability); willing targets auto; unconscious auto-lose
cost.timing: instant abilities in powers phase by INT rank; longer ones announced on DEX rank, take effect next round

successLevels.fumble: all PP lost; Idea roll or stunned rest of round
successLevels.special: one of: half PP (min 1), ×2 range, ×2 duration, ×2 damage, better info, characteristic ×1.5
successLevels.critical: one of: PP cost 1, ×3 range, ×3 duration, ×2 damage no armor, exceptional info, characteristic ×2

rules.note: Experience check on success in combat or danger; training/research also works.
Only after POW exceeds its starting value.
Training: mentor at 75%+, (POW−30) weeks [as printed], sacrifice 1 POW, Luck roll; rated POW×1.
Involuntary: GM-staged trauma/mutagen, sacrifice 2 POW, new ability at POW×5.
Beat a higher POW in a resistance roll -> POW experience check.
Both must be astral, within the higher POW in meters; order by INT.
Each round PP vs PP: both succeed -> both lose 1D3 PP; one succeeds -> other loses 1D3; neither -> nothing. Overflow below 0 PP hits HP.
Winner may press on vs unconscious foe (attacker PP vs victim POW) for 1D3 HP losses; 0 HP = dead. GM may drop this.
Time steps by PP: 1 round, 10 rounds, 1 full turn, 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 1 year, 10 years, 100 years (1–10).

list.name: Astral Projection
list.effect: Leave body as invisible astral form; body comatose; +1 PP to enter astral space.

list.name: Aura Detection
list.effect: Read a being’s aura (health, alignment, PP, relative power) with Idea roll.

list.name: Clairvoyance
list.effect: Project senses to a distant location.

list.name: Cryokinesis
list.cost: 3 PP per 1D6 dmg or per 3 SIZ
list.effect: Freeze target: PP vs CON, 1D6 per 3 PP; can chill/ice an area or object.

list.name: Danger Sense

list.name: Dead Calm
list.effect: Steel against mental shock; PP vs SAN lost to delay sanity effects.

list.name: Divination
list.cost: 10 PP (+1 per hour of prep cut)
list.effect: Ask a higher power for a guiding vision.
list.duration: 10 hours prep (−1 h per extra PP); vision instant

list.name: Eidetic Memory
list.effect: Perfect recall of past experience.

list.name: Emotion Control
list.effect: Impose an emotion on target(s), opposed by INT; target may retry each turn.

list.name: Empathy
list.effect: Sense a target’s feelings; POW vs POW for deeper insight.

list.name: Intuition
list.effect: Home in on a specific person or class of item.

list.name: Levitation

list.name: Mind Blast

list.effect: PP vs PP mental strike stuns; special = out 1D6 turns, critical 1D6 hours.

list.name: Mind Control

list.effect: Take over a target’s body and will after PP vs PP; target may retry to break.

list.name: Precognition

list.effect: Read past emotions/events tied to an object or place.

list.name: Pyrokinesis
list.effect: Heat target: 1D6 per 3 PP; can melt objects (PP vs SIZ).

list.name: Sensitivity
list.effect: Detect psychic emanations or supernatural beings nearby.

list.name: Telekinesis
list.effect: Move objects by mind; unwilling POW vs SIZ; damage mod from POW+INT.

list.name: Telepathy
list.cost: 1 PP to activate or 1 per 3 POW
list.effect: Read minds (POW vs POW each round) or speak mind-to-mind.

resource.spend: spell level = PP cost (1 PP per level); some spells also cost permanent POW
resource.recovery: natural regeneration up to POW (PP above POW spendable but not regenerated)

cost.activation: automatic, no skill roll; only fails if target resists (caster PP vs target PP) or caster distracted (Idea roll)
cost.levelRange: variable spells: choose level within (min–max) when casting
cost.readyTime: 1 combat round per spell point (max level)

rules.note: Need POW 16+ to cast.
Spell levels in memory ≤ INT; bound demons/elementals count; enchanted items do not.
Lost grimoire: memorized spells re-recorded free; once per day INT×1 to recall another.
Casting takes 1 round; non-memorized sorcery generally unusable in combat.
Research: library ×1–3; 1D10 weeks −1/50% language (min 1); success ≤ INT×rating; fail = another 1D10 weeks.
Foreign grimoire: INT×1 per 3 weeks; Language roll if language skill < INT×5.
Teacher: one spell at a time, INT×1 roll.
Ready: 1 round per point of spell (max value); dismiss: instant.
Cast in powers phase by INT; effect lands next round powers phase; nothing else that round.
Lasts caster POW in combat rounds; recast to extend, no intensify; caster may end early.
Exercising power: beat equal/higher POW -> POW check.
Sorcerous heritage: at creation trade 2 characteristic points for 1 POW, Luck roll each; not with point-buy.
Gift of the gods: up to 1D3 POW, each point owes a dangerous deed.
Weapon spells add to rolled damage but capped at weapon maximum (plus damage modifier).
One spell per object; extra spell dissipates, PP lost.
Compatible spells can stack on a person (GM call).
Compare current PP including those being spent; subtract afterwards.
Cross-plane casting: ×2 PP, ½ duration/effect, Difficult Luck roll.
Summon demon 9 PP total, 1D8 hours; binding 1 permanent POW (3 for object binding) + POW vs demon POW; demon POW dice count vs INT limit.

list.name: Bird’s Vision (1)
list.effect: See through the eyes of a visible bird.

list.name: Bolster the Soul (1–3)
list.effect: +3 POW per level.

list.name: Bounty of the Sea (4)
list.effect: Fill an area with water.

list.name: Brazier of Power (4)
list.effect: Create a reservoir that stores power points.

list.name: Breath of Life (1)

equipmentRules.note: +dm adds the full damage modifier; +½dm adds half of it, rounded up (thrown/missile weapons).
Special = special-success type: Bleeding, Crushing, Impaling, Entangle, Knockback, Stun, Fire.
Range: base range unmodified; x2 range Difficult; x4 range at 1/5 skill.
Hands: 1H one-handed, 2H two-handed; "1H or 2H" usable either way.
Below a weapon's min STR/DEX the GM may impose penalties (e.g. Difficult rolls).
RF = volley rate of fire: 1/#CR means one use every # rounds; X/CR = X uses per round.
Mal: attack roll at/above this number = malfunction (mishap for non-firearms).
A specialty covers every weapon in its class.
Cross-class weapon use at Difficult (half) rating; experience goes to the base skill.
Katana / bastard sword one-handed: only half damage modifier.
Primitive/ancient armor counts half vs high-velocity or energy weapons; modern armor half vs energy.
Advanced armor protects fully (GM may halve vs energy). Random AV: roll, then halve.
Revolver carried with empty hammer chamber: ammo -1; fully loaded risks discharge on Luck failure.
Malfunction: revolvers/bolt/double-barrel = dud (1 round to clear); autos/pumps/levers = jam.
Clearing a jam: 1D6 rounds + firearm or Repair roll; 96-00 on that roll ruins the gun.
Reload: 2 rounds per CR, swap clip/cell 1 CR, MG belt 2 CR; single quick-load shot at half DEX rank.
Unaimed fire: double Attk, hit at 1/5 skill (GM may waive: laser sight + skill over 60%).
Armor ENC listed for SIZ 11-15; x0.8 for SIZ 6-10, x1.2 for 16-20, x1.4 for 21-25 (round up).
Armor AV is not worn down by combat damage.
No helmet: -1 AV (light helmet) or -2 AV (heavy) from suits that include one.
Hit-location ENC share: head 1/10, each arm 1/10, chest 1/5, abdomen 1/10, each leg 1/5.
Soft armor layers add AV and ENC; layering hard armors adds AV but triples lesser armor ENC.
Donning armor: 1 combat round per AV point.
Removing armor: 3 AV per round (4 with an Agility success); use max AV if random.
Armor by location: burden/skill modifier from heaviest torso/leg piece; 1 round per 5 AV to don.
Helmet AV when using hit locations: Prim 2; Anc heavy 8/light 4; Mod 8/6; Adv 16/14.
Thrown shield = improvised weapon, 10 m range, 05% base.
Shield AV doubles as its HP; below min STR/DEX all shield use is Difficult.
Slung shield adds half AV (round up) to covered locations; buckler/primitive/energy cannot.
Artillery damage falls 1D6 per meter beyond initial radius.
Artillery crew below listed number: attacks are Difficult.
Artillery hits a SIZ 40 area; -1% to hit per SIZ point the target is under 40.
Guided missile: skill is Easy; self-guided hits except 99-00; dodging it is Difficult.
Shrapnel: 1/6 solid-shot damage, applied within radius (m) = number of solid damage dice.
Explosive Dmg "XdY/N meters": full dice within N m, then reduced beyond.
